name: Taisho Pharmaceutical Holdings Co., Ltd.
note: Holding company of Taisho Pharmaceutical Co., Ltd. Taken private in 2024 in Japan's largest management buyout: Otemon, the acquisition vehicle of the founding Uehara family led by Shigeru Uehara, secured a 73% stake in the tender offer and moved to acquire the remaining shares; the shares were delisted from the Tokyo Stock Exchange on 2024-04-09.
